gaps.sentence: No sooner had the applause died ___ the encore began.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner... than' is invariable; 'when' would be wrong here.

gaps.sentence: ___ the north coast is rocky, the southern beaches are soft golden sand.
gaps.explanation: 'While' can contrast two clauses in a single sentence.

gaps.sentence: The flight was delayed ___ thick fog.
gaps.explanation: 'Because of' + noun phrase gives the cause; although/despite express contrast.

gaps.sentence: She has decided to cycle to work ___ taking the bus.
gaps.explanation: 'Instead of + -ing' = in place of the bus journey.

gaps.sentence: The old system charged per download, ___ the new one uses a flat monthly fee.
gaps.explanation: 'Whereas' sets the old and new systems side by side.

gaps.sentence: ___ one misplaced comma, the essay is flawless.
gaps.explanation: 'Apart from' = except for, introducing the single exception.

gaps.sentence: He talks ___ he owned the place.
gaps.explanation: 'As if/though + past' describes behaviour contrary to fact (he doesn't own it).

gaps.sentence: I enjoyed the film; the ending was weak, ___.
gaps.explanation: 'Though' can come at the end of a sentence as a casual contrast marker; the others cannot.
